# Clinical Case Management Platform (CCMP `v1.1.0`) — Technical Reference

CCMP combines 4 Next.js 15 portals (`patient-web`, `clinician-web`, `admin-web`, `analytics-web`), Fastify 5.1 (`services/api`), Prisma 6.2 (`packages/database`), LiveKit WebRTC SFU, and Flutter mobile/desktop apps (`flutter/apps/{patient,clinician,desktop}`).

Key safeguards:
- Dual-jurisdiction data residency routing (Nigeria NDPA 2023 & UK GDPR / DPA 2018)
- Real-time drug-allergy blocking engine & assistive AI Scribe requiring clinician sign-off
- SHA-256 chained cryptographic audit trail across prescriptions, addenda, and record access
- WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA clinical design system
